thought.text: The register endpoint is public. Let me run a full end-to-end flow: register a user, log in, and make an authenticated API call.

reasoning_content:
The register endpoint is publicly accessible. Let's test the full flow: user registration → login → authenticated request. This will let us verify that the backend is fully functional (DB writes, JWT auth, API).

Let's register a user and log in.

action.command:
TS="tsval$(date +%s)"; echo "=== REGISTER $TS ==="; curl -s -w "
[HTTP %{http_code}]
" -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/register -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{"username":"$TS","password":"Test1234!","email":"$TS@example.com"}" ; echo "=== LOGIN ==="; curl -s -c /tmp/ts-cookies.txt -w "
[HTTP %{http_code}]
" -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{"username":"$TS","password":"Test1234!"}"; echo "=== AUTH HEALTH (with cookie) ==="; curl -s -b /tmp/ts-cookies.txt -w "
[HTTP %{http_code}]
" http://localhost:8000/api/health

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"summary": "Test full register-login-authenticated API flow", "command": "TS=\"tsval$(date +%s)\"; echo \"=== REGISTER $TS ===\"; curl -s -w \"\\n[HTTP %{http_code}]\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/register -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d \"{\\\"username\\\":\\\"$TS\\\",\\\"password\\\":\\\"Test1234!\\\",\\\"email\\\":\\\"$TS@example.com\\\"}\" ; echo \"=== LOGIN ===\"; curl -s -c /tmp/ts-cookies.txt -w \"\\n[HTTP %{http_code}]\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/login -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d \"{\\\"username\\\":\\\"$TS\\\",\\\"password\\\":\\\"Test1234!\\\"}\"; echo \"=== AUTH HEALTH (with cookie) ===\"; curl -s -b /tmp/ts-cookies.txt -w \"\\n[HTTP %{http_code}]\\n\" http://localhost:8000/api/health", "security_risk": "LOW"}
